slides: Your body is a thermostat, not a time bomb.
Every step you take resets its set point.
Idle days let the thermostat drift low.
Consistent micro‑moves keep it firing at peak.
Move daily, and energy becomes your default.
Choices are the currency of freedom.
Spend them on the future, not the impulse.
Each deferred craving adds interest.
Your ledger tallies confidence over time.
Choose tomorrow, and own today.
Strength isn’t a sprint; it’s a marathon of tension.
Muscles adapt to the longest‑held load.
Short bursts train nerves, not fibers.
Slow, controlled reps build resilient tissue.
Train for durability, not just size.
Habits are dominoes; you only need one push.
Link a new act to an existing routine.
The cue is already in place.
The reward rides the old habit’s finish.
Stack wisely, and growth compounds.
